# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the runtime outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List tests, type checks, lint, contract checks, and evaluation commands run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or the reason tests are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Documentation and evaluation methodology are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Public Python imports, HTTP APIs, JSON Schemas, and Go integration impact is described.
- [ ] Persistence or data migration and rollback impact is described.
- [ ] Security, approvals, grounding, traces, and privacy impact is reviewed.
- [ ] Generated contracts and reports came from their source commands.
